answer.rationale: memory_73 (targeted promotional pricing) is weakly supported for sustainable long-term qualified revenue because aggressive discounting to price-sensitive segments creates retention and margin risks that aren't measured in the record—it captures acquisition lift but omits data on churn, unit economics, or customer lifetime value. memory_57 (referrals) and memory_31 (signup simplification) earn 4s because they show durable activation gains without documented harm. memory_86 (onboarding shortening) earns 4 for the same reason: measurable adoption lift. memory_91 (activation messaging) earns 3 because it shows engagement improvement but lacks retention or revenue outcome data. memory_44 (sales-assisted enterprise) earns 5 because enterprise conversion and pipeline quality directly support long-term qualified revenue and typically indicate higher LTV and retention. memory_73 earns only 2 because relying on price competition is inherently unsustainable and the record shows no evidence of revenue quality, retention, or whether these accounts stay profitable or loyal.
